scripts.build: vite build && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist/types && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('src/shims.d.ts','dist/types/shims.d.ts');const f='dist/types/index.d.ts';const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!s.startsWith('/// <reference path=\"./shims.d.ts\"'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'/// <reference path=\"./shims.d.ts\" />\n'+s)"
